title: Add release team - `b_robotized`
author: Nibanovic
body:
* Name of the new release team: b_robotized
* Release repositories to add:
  <!--
  Before release repositories are created, repositories and packages should be submitted to the official rosdistro repository https://github.com/ros/rosdistro for naming review.
  The ros/rosdistro source entry link must be included for each repository.
  Guidelines for package naming are describe in REP-144: https://www.ros.org/reps/rep-0144.html

  If there are any existing release repositories which should have their contents imported into the ros2-gbp organization, list and link to them here.
  Leave the checkbox _unchecked_. The ros2-gbp administrator will check the box when they have completed the repository import.
  -->
  * [beckhoff_ads_driver](https://github.com/b-robotized/beckhoff_ads_driver)
    * [ros/rosdistro source entry] [jazzy](https://github.com/b-robotized-forks/rosdistro/blob/8179a79d5a0719c1b1defd62ad430915aee17ce0/jazzy/distribution.yaml#L914-L922) [rolling](https://github.com/b-robotized-forks/rosdistro/blob/8179a79d5a0719c1b1defd62ad430915aee17ce0/rolling/distribution.yaml#L868-L876) [kilted](https://github.com/b-robotized-forks/rosdistro/blob/8179a79d5a0719c1b1defd62ad430915aee17ce0/kilted/distribution.yaml#L790-L798)
  * [ads_vendor](https://github.com/b-robotized/ads_vendor)
    * [ros/rosdistro source entry] [jazzy](https://github.com/b-robotized-forks/rosdistro/blob/ca1b150bc94e76e207a128a40f6aef35c696f4fc/jazzy/distribution.yaml#L97-L102) [rolling](https://github.com/b-robotized-forks/rosdistro/blob/ca1b150bc94e76e207a128a40f6aef35c696f4fc/rolling/distribution.yaml#L97-L102) [kilted](https://github.com/b-robotized-forks/rosdistro/blob/ca1b150bc94e76e207a128a40f6aef35c696f4fc/kilted/distribution.yaml#L97-L102)
